title: Workflow throughput public verification
summary: Merged workflow changes reached production, and CI verified the deployment and public site identity on both supported addresses.
details: PR #70 merged as 5daed8fc1c3c3bb1bafcac583409f8e7a728e8bc. CI run 38509727485 passed build, deployment, public identity/hash, and devlog checks on both public addresses. The trusted Rust app cache completed successfully from 04:10:43 to 04:10:51 UTC. Public tools/test_devlog.mjs passed with 222 checkpoints and 30 feature areas, desktop/mobile filters, no 390px overflow, and no browser errors. This verification exercises the metadata-only release lane; its speedup has not yet been measured.
limitation: The warm Rust app-cache runtime speedup remains unmeasured; no new screenshot was captured for this tooling checkpoint.
